verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Kong's AI Gateway can apply DLP policies to strip PII from traffic (kong-docs-60) and logs are stored locally/in Docker (kong-docs-69, kong-docs-73), but there is no documentation of configurable data retention periods, deletion APIs, or user-facing controls to purge stored logs/traffic data. As an AI gateway handling AI traffic and logs, this axis is applicable, but no evidence demonstrates retention/deletion controls exist.
